headline: Divgi Torqtransfer Systems Limited: Acquisition
sum: Acquisition — Divgi Torqtransfer Systems Limited has informed the Exchange in reference to disclosure dated May 25, 2026, it is being intimated that as per approval of State of Secretary of Delaware, USA, a proposed wholly-owned subsidiary…
detail: Acquisition — Divgi Torqtransfer Systems Limited has informed the Exchange in reference to disclosure dated May 25, 2026, it is being intimated that as per approval of State of Secretary of Delaware, USA, a proposed wholly-owned subsidiary under the name and style of Divgi Transmission Technologies and Systems Inc is incorporated on June 04, 2026
